Subject: Recap & next steps  Redwood + Acme discovery (economic buyer / budget owner)

Thanks again for the time today, Jared  appreciate the thoughtful intro to your team. Quick recap from our side and a concrete ask to keep momentum.

Key takeaways (from discovery):
- Use case: internal developer tooling + semantic search for product docs (primary), ~35M tokens/month in steady state.
- Decision criteria: latency under 200ms for search & snippets, cost per 1M tokens, security posture (VPC/KMS), and audit logging.
- Timeline: procurement window targeted end of Q2; proof-of-concept (PoC) in the next 23 weeks.

Open items / asks:
1) Economic buyer / budget owner  would you be able to introduce the person who owns the budget? We typically like to include them early so we can align on cost model and procurement timeline.
2) Security & procurement contacts  you mentioned Lisa in security and procurement@acmecorp.com; if possible please loop them into the PoC planning thread.
3) PoC success criteria  we'd propose a short mutual action plan (scope, duration, metrics). I can draft a 1page MAP once we have the budget owner on the thread.

Proposed next steps:
- Intro to economic buyer + procurement and security (this week)
- 30-min alignment call with the budget owner to confirm SLAs and high-level TCO (goal: confirm Go/No-go for PoC)
- Shared MAP and test data instructions (I can send a draft within 24 hours of intro)

Attachments: vendor-eval-schedule.pdf (1page timeline we use for PoC planning)

Thanks  Neha
